artworks.title: Le char de l'état en 1871
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn cart. The image features a cart with large wheels being pulled by two horses. Two characters are seen in the cart; one is controlling the horses with a whip, while the other sits beside them. Above the characters are words "VERSAILLES" and "PARIS." The drawing is done in a bold outlined style with hatching to emphasize texture and shadow, creating a stark monochrome illustration. The scene seems to convey a political or social message through the characters and their expressions.

artworks.title: Déjà relevée!
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring allegorical elements related to France and an 'EMPRUNT' (loan). The drawing depicts a monumental figure representing France standing atop a large globe-like form with the word 'EMPRUNT' inscribed on it. Below, several figures appear to be observing the monumental figure. The composition uses sharp lines and a high contrast of black and white. The style is reminiscent of 19th-century satirical illustrations.

artworks.title: La république de Milo...
artworks.description: The image shows a classical female sculpture standing gracefully with her head turned to one side. She is depicted in monochromatic shading, likely in black and white, standing on a pedestal. Men wearing hats are looking up at the sculpture. The word "République" is sketched onto the lower section of the sculpture.

artworks.title: Théâtre de Bordeaux - on joue la tragédie
artworks.description: This is a monochrome drawing of a stage performance at the "Theatre de Bordeaux." The illustration depicts a figure on stage in a costume and holding a staff, standing over another figure on the ground. The audience is shown from behind, with many heads conveying attention. The drawing highlights the dramatic tension and balance between the stage action and the attending crowd with contrast and pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Ce pauvre Louis XIV n'en croyant pas ses yeux
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rider on a horse gesturing towards a doorway marked "REPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE ASSEMBLÉE NATIONALE". The drawing features a dramatic and expressive style with heavy use of lines and shading. The rider is depicted in a dynamic pose with arms raised and head thrown back. The horse is drawn in a rearing position, adding to the sense of drama. The sign indicates the French National Assembly. The background includes radiating lines that add to the sense of motion and energy.

artworks.title: Le Président de Rhodes
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a figure standing with one leg on each of two separate land masses, stretching across a body of water. The figure has exaggerated muscular features, an oversized head, a swirl of hair on top, and wears glasses. The facial features include a pronounced brow, a prominent nose, and a serious expression. The figure is portrayed wearing shorts and appears in a posture of power. In the background, a boat with a sail can be seen navigating the water. The land masses are labeled "BISCUITERIE" and "CHOLE." The scene is drawn in monochrome.

artworks.title: Je vous assure que vous serez très bien assise
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene between two figures. One figure on the left symbolizes France, holding a shield that bears the name "FRANCE," and standing resolutely. The other figure on the right is depicted as an elderly, hunched-over figure with a tattered appearance, labeled "ARBITRE," pushing a chair labeled "MONARCHIE" towards the central space between them. The chair has a worn cushion. The drawing features intricate line work accentuating the expressions and demeanor of the figures.

artworks.title: Chère dame, avant de nous donner...
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two figures. One figure is a jester holding a stick, while the other figure is an elderly woman labeled "Reaction" using a cane. The woman leans forward as if engaged in conversation. The drawing is in monochrome with bold line work.

artworks.title: Après la pompe a sang, la pompe à or
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man using a pump to extract coins from France. A large figure operates a hand pump embedded in a globe. The pump is positioned in the area labeled "France," and coins flow into a hat on the ground. The hat overflows with coins. The globe features "France" and "Europe" as geographical labels. The drawing style suggests commentary or satire, possibly related to economic or political themes.

artworks.title: Vous n'avez pas besoin de me rappeler ses titres...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing in a coastal landscape. The man on the left is holding a cane and wearing a hat and long coat, facing away from the viewer. The man on the right is gesturing with his left hand, resting his right hand on a spade stuck in the ground. He has sharp facial features and tousled hair, wearing a loose-fitting shirt and pants. In the background are rocks, the sea, and distant cliff formations or rock islands.

artworks.title: Avis aux amateurs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three crouching figures in front of a box labeled "Plebiscite" with holes dated 1851, 1870, and 18... . The drawing features three dated entries with the last date incomplete. The drawing features coiled wire or rod structures above the box. The use of shading and line work adds depth and contrast to the image. The drawing is presented in a layout typical of a newspaper page.

artworks.title: Ce qui ramènera... nos députés à Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in motion. The drawing depicts several figures, all facing in the same direction, with one prominent figure struggling against a force that pulls at their clothing. The figures appear to lean forward. The scene conveys a sense of motion and urgency, with detailed line work that emphasizes the flow of the clothing and the dynamics of movement. The background is sparse, with only faint outlines suggesting a distant landscape or horizon.

artworks.title: Tirez, ça fait équilibre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical statue labeled "Republique" on a pedestal. Two hands on either side of the statue are pulling ropes attached to it. The caption below states that an equilibrium is achieved through this tension. The image suggests a representation of political or social tensions. The style is simplistic and conveys the message through line drawing and shading.

artworks.title: Prenez garde, madame la Majorité!
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure on the left stands upright with arms crossed, wearing a headscarf and a long-sleeved dress. The other figure on the right leans forward, dressed in a jester's outfit, holding a scepter. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface with text along the top.

artworks.title: Bien vexés de ne pas trouver... la couronne...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures near a fireplace. Two figures are standing next to bottles, while the third figure is kneeling, wearing a sash reading "CAISSETTE DE FRANCE," and interacting with the fireplace. The style appears to be caricature, with exaggerated features and postures. Details in clothing and actions suggest potential social or political commentary. Lines are prominently used to create texture and expression in this monochromatic composition.

artworks.title: Notre dernier gateau des rois
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fortress-shaped cake topped with a military helmet. The drawing features a round cake that resembles a fortress, complete with battlements and an arched doorway. The word "SEDAN" is prominently displayed on the side of the cake. Resting atop the cake is a spiked military helmet with a detailed insignia on its front. The entire cake and helmet combination is presented on a platter, held by a hand visible at the edge of the image.

artworks.title: Voila bien des oeufs de cassés...
artworks.description: The illustration shows two men from the waist up, positioned side by side. The man on the left is standing with his hands near his chest, holding a small object. He has a prominent nose and a pointed chin, wears round spectacles, and has a hat on his head with tied strings at the back. His attire includes a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt. Next to him, the man on the right is leaning slightly forward as he cooks. He has an elongated nose and a slightly open mouth, with short hair peeking from under a conical hat. His attire consists of a long apron. He is holding a frying pan over what appears to be a weathered stove, with smoke billowing up. Lying on the floor beneath them are broken eggshells. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: Une Situation désagréable
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a large figure with the word "HOLSTEIN" under it. Two smaller caricatured figures stand on top of the large figure, holding rod-like objects and appearing to be mock fighting. The large figure looks uncomfortable and distressed. The drawing uses exaggerated features and poses to create a humorous effect, with detailed line work and shading adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Changeant son cheval borgne pour un aveugle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a comical scene featuring a character labeled "John Bull" riding two horses. The drawing depicts "John Bull" in a caricature style, balancing himself on two horses labeled "Ministère WICH" and "Ministère TORY." The character holds a whip in one hand as if urging the horses onward. The drawing captures a dynamic movement and exaggerated features, characteristic of political satire from the time period. The intricate lines and shading create a vivid monochrome illustration with a sense of irony and humor.

artworks.title: Se demandant si, le duel fini, ils ne vont pas etre plumes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two anthropomorphic birds dressed in human clothing engaged in a duel, set against a backdrop of a satirical map. The drawing depicts two bird-like figures with exaggerated human attributes, standing in a handshake pose, each holding a sword. The figures are detailed with long beaks and plumed hats, and they wear shirts with rolled-up sleeves and pants. The scene appears to represent a duel. The background contains outlines of birds with names such as 'BAVOIRE,' 'HESSE,' and 'SAXE.'

artworks.title: Renouvele de Gulliver
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a giant figure in military attire surrounded by much smaller figures. The main subject is a large figure dressed in a textured uniform, wearing a spiked helmet, and bending forward. The figure's facial expression appears determined or aggressive. This imposing figure holds small figures in one hand and carries more on its back. The background shows a crowd of smaller figures in a chaotic scene, emphasizing the size difference. The style of the drawing is distinctive with strong lines and shading, giving it a dynamic energy.

artworks.title: Attendez... il faut encore ceci...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures. Two figures are seated on makeshift scales while a third figure adds a box labeled "Venetie". The drawing features a humorous or satirical scene where figures are being weighed on the scales. The scales are suspended from a horizontal beam and the drawing is in a style typical of satirical cartoons or caricatures. The characters are exaggerated in their features, emphasizing the underlying message or criticism of the artwork.

artworks.title: Voyons!... debout, on nous regarde
artworks.description: The image features a cartoon illustration with two full-body figures in a dynamic pose. The figure on the left is an older man with a long, bushy beard, a knit cap, a dark coat with buttons, striped pants, and bare feet, holding a curved pipe emitting smoke. The figure on the right is a woman with long dark hair, wearing a crown or headband and a long flowing dress, standing with an arm around the man's shoulders and another around his waist. Both are barefoot. The background is simple and shaded, without specific details. The image is labeled "Actualités" with a page number "199," and includes a French caption below.

artworks.title: Il se plaint de rentrer...
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in motion. On the left, a man is leaning forward with his head in one hand next to an archway labeled "COLLÉGE." On the right, another man is in front of a doorway labeled "PLACERVIAT." He is gesturing towards the first man. The man on the right has a wrinkled face and a long nose, wearing period clothing and holding his coat. The background shows architectural features and a street setting.
